parsed.notes:
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS sets required labels; PREFERRED / BONUS sets optional labels. Responsibilities and company-description technologies were excluded.
The outer 'one or more of the following' offers alternative bundles, including conjunctions and nested alternatives. The flat alternative_group field cannot faithfully encode these bundles; their mapped skills are flagged for review and outer grouping is left unresolved. Group numbers cover only the two unambiguous mapped sets, not a completed grouping review.
ML frameworks is provisionally mapped to machine-learning; the taxonomy has no separate generic ML-frameworks entry.
Triton names a compiler infrastructure here, not Triton Inference Server, so it is unmapped.
Memory hierarchies, latency, cycles, memory bandwidth, and arithmetic intensity are treated literally as domain knowledge rather than standalone technical practices.
The two preferred-section unmapped items are nice-to-have; the other unmapped items occur in required qualifications, some within alternatives.
The required degree list explicitly includes PhD, so the highest named degree is required despite the separate preferred PhD mention.
Deep experience and deep expertise are not seniority signals under the guide.
